verdict.rationale: Pika documents an API ('Pika API Club') and an MCP integration for agents, so credential scoping is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence describes issuing API keys, scoping them, or least-privilege permissions for agent credentials. Having an API and MCP is adjacent and does not show scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
